evidence.note: CLI writes dedupe as dedupe || O.isSome(moveDuplicatesTo) before NormalizeFilesOptions.make, so a move-duplicates path cannot be stored with dedupe false.
normalizeFilesImpl reconverges the same implication before planning: presence of moveDuplicatesTo forces dedupe true; dedupe-without-move remains legal.

notes: Omitted correlated payload on the seeded [dedupe, dryRun, overwrite] owner. Legal: off | dedupe-only | move-to(path) (move implies dedupe).

evidence.note: buildNormalizePlan copies already-coerced options.dedupe plus duplicateDirectory into NormalizeManifestOptions; moveDuplicatesTo present never ships with dedupe false.
makeNormalizeManifest persists plan.options (NormalizeManifestOptions) into the on-disk normalize-manifest.json.

notes: JSON-safe options nested in NormalizeManifest. Seed [dedupe, overwrite] omitted the moveDuplicatesTo implication axis.
